## Decisions

- **Use statement-level trigger for push dispatch**: Batches multi-recipient notifications into a single HTTP POST request to /api/push/dispatch, reducing webhook overhead.
- **Include local development fallback in internal_post**: Allows local development instances to function seamlessly when Vault secrets are not yet initialized.
